lesson.subtitle: Lesson 1 -- Nice to Meet You
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ender de Souza Batista | Lesson 1 -- Nice to Meet You
lesson.grammar_point: verb to be (I am, you are, he/she/it is, we/they are: affirmative, negative and questions)

listenings.text: Welcome to the Mastercard global partner call. Your host today is Sarah Miller. The call is one hour. When it is your turn, please say your name, your company and your country. The call is in English. Thank you, and welcome.

Hello, everyone. My name is Raj Patel. I am an engineer at Mastercard. I am in Pune, in India, and it is five thirty in the afternoon here. My team is small: we are four people. Today I am here for your questions about the new rule. Thank you.

extra_audio.text: Ender is on a global call. Sarah is the host, and she is in New York. Ender says: I am the technology director. Sarah asks: Is your team on the call? Ender says: No, they are not online now.
